snippet.title: Atari 2600 Myst Demake Longplay
snippet.description:
A playthough of the Atari 2600 Myst Demake on actual hardware.

This all fits on a 16k cartridge, you can walk around Myst island, get all 4 endings, complete two puzzles, and do the full speedrun route.

For more info see: http://deater.net/weave/vmwprod/myst_vcs/
